goal: Hand-author a valid Pod manifest field by field — using kubectl explain and --dry-run=client as the authoring tools — then run it, serve real content from a ConfigMap, and diagnose an ImagePullBackOff caused by a single mistyped tag.
produces: A depot-web Pod in kcna-lab02 serving data/depot-status.html and data/depots.csv from the ConfigMap depot-content
A learner-authored manifest in /tmp that round-trips cleanly against manifests/20-depot-web-pod.yaml
A documented ImagePullBackOff diagnosis with the exact kubelet Failed event text
concepts: The five top-level fields every object has: apiVersion, kind, metadata, spec, status
kubectl explain and --dry-run=client -o yaml as manifest authoring aids, not toys
containerPort is documentation, not a firewall or a publish rule
Waiting-state reasons: ImagePullBackOff, ErrImagePull and the backoff loop behind them
